title: HarnessOpt-Bench measures whether models can improve the systems around them
friendlyTitle: A new test asks AI to improve its own agent setup
summary: HarnessOpt-Bench evaluates models that edit an agent’s prompts, tools, memory and orchestration under a fixed evaluation budget. Across 111 runs involving five frontier models and four tasks, model choice separated results more clearly than the coding harness, and native harnesses were not consistently best.
friendlySummary: Models were asked to improve the prompts, tools and control code around an agent. Results depended more on the model than on which coding tool it used.
whyItMatters: Agent performance depends on the surrounding system as well as model weights. Builders need held-out tests and strict budgets when allowing AI to optimize that system, because improvements can be task-specific and easy to overfit.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Better setup can improve an agent without training a new model. Use hidden tests so the AI does not simply learn to pass the examples it can see.
